chapter_keywords: a record of a mortal's journey to immortality
chapter_seo_title: RMJI Ch. 279 – Making a Move: Han Li's One-Shot Massacre of Qi Condensation Thugs
chapter_meta_description: Han Li finds the array master's co-creator, Qi Yunxiao, but a rescue crisis interrupts their negotiation. With cold precision, he annihilates a group of Qi Condensation attackers, securing a massive debt of gratitude while demonstrating the absolute power of the Foundation Establishment realm.
og_title: RMJI Ch. 279 – Han Li's Absolute Power Display
og_description: Qi Yunxiao begs for help, and Han Li obliges by effortlessly killing seven Qi Condensation foes in an instant. A classic Mortal Stream power demonstration.
twitter_description: Han Li wipes out an entire team of Qi Condensation cultivators with a single attack. The gap between realms is terrifyingly absolute.

lore_anchors.definition: The second major realm in the cultivation system, granting qualitatively superior mana density, reflexes, and the ability to use magical tools effectively over long range.

The first major cultivation realm; the stage where practitioners are still considered “mortal” in the face of true cultivators. Even the highest layers (11-12) are child’s play against a Foundation Establishment cultivator.
A speed-focused flying artifact capable of short-range rapid transport; its speed is far superior to ordinary Qi Condensation flight.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why didn't Han Li just take the array tools?
cultural_notes_faq.a: Because he wanted the array master to fix his teleportation array, which was a bigger prize. Taking the immediate reward would have made the later, more important request seem greedy and might have soured the relationship.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why did Han Li want to kill everyone?
cultural_notes_faq.a: This is the "cut the grass and pull the roots" principle. If he scared the attackers off, they would return with more people from their clan. Killing them all prevents future retaliation and ensures the array master's long-term safety, securing Han Li's investment in her goodwill.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Is it realistic for a Foundation Establishment cultivator to kill so many Qi Condensation cultivators at once?
cultural_notes_faq.a: Yes, in the cultivation world's rigid hierarchy. The difference in mana quality, reaction speed, and tool power is absolute. To a Foundation Establishment cultivator, even a Qi Condensation Layer 12 expert is as fragile and slow as a mortal child. This scene demonstrates the harsh, unforgiving class structure of the realm.
